description: Parking Occupancy Level is a dataset listed in Liverpool City Council open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Liverpool City Council. This dataset stores the occupancy level of parking spots monitored by Sage parking sensors and computed every 15 mins. Coverage: Liverpool, New South Wales. The portal files it under Roads, Parking and Transport. Its keywords are parking, mobility, Active transport. The portal shows 49,585 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-liverpool-nsw-gov-au-portal.
